import subprocess,sys,re
db=next((x for x in subprocess.check_output(["docker","ps","--format","{{.Names}}"],text=True).splitlines() if re.search(r"postgres|database|db-[0-9]",x,re.I)),None)
if not db:sys.exit(81)
sql="""SELECT chat_id,message_thread_id,title,verified_by FROM posting_topics
WHERE chat_id IN (-1002373696859,-1003770334893)
AND enabled=TRUE AND verified_at IS NOT NULL
AND (title ILIKE '%ビデオ%' OR message_thread_id=1695)
ORDER BY chat_id,message_thread_id"""
p=subprocess.run(["docker","exec",db,"sh","-c",'psql -qAt -F "|" -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -c "$1"',"sh",sql],text=True,capture_output=True)
if p.returncode:sys.exit(82)
rows=[line.split("|") for line in p.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]
v=[r for r in rows if r[0]=="-1002373696859" and r[1]=="1695"]
g=[r for r in rows if r[0]=="-1003770334893" and "ビデオ" in r[2] and "チャット" in r[2] and "専用" in r[2]]
if len(v)!=1:sys.exit(83)
if len(g)!=1:sys.exit(84)
if any(len(r)!=4 or not r[3].isdigit() for r in v+g):sys.exit(85)
print("TWO_VERIFIED_VIDEO_TOPIC_TARGETS=PASS")
PY
